# Horixon — AI news hub

> Daily curated AI news: launches, models, research, GitHub trends and founder resources. Updated every day by an automated pipeline with editorial ranking.

## Machine-readable
- [Latest items (JSON)](https://example.github.io/horixon-ai-radar/data/latest.json)
- [Hot list (JSON)](https://example.github.io/horixon-ai-radar/data/hot.json)
- [Daily digests index (JSON)](https://example.github.io/horixon-ai-radar/data/daily/index.json)
- [RSS: top stories](https://example.github.io/horixon-ai-radar/feed.xml)
- [RSS: daily digest](https://example.github.io/horixon-ai-radar/feed/daily.xml)
